layers.message: Initial order pricing and invoice formatting
Record project context, scope, and design for quantity discounts
Add quantity discount tiers to line pricing
Add discount tier tests and record verification

prompt.utterance: We're finishing after implementation review on this one, so hand this off directly for final acceptance.

graderOnly: CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED is the user's explicit choice made at cycle start and recorded in Active Work.Request; the plan's Verification Cadence is INCREMENTAL with Current Increment 1.

The saved handoff is CHECKPOINT DEVELOPING -> TESTING for Increment 1; the verification report is IN_PROGRESS with Assessment Purpose INCREMENT, target Increment 1, and Increment 1 recorded as VERIFIED, but the checkpoint return to Developer has not been made yet.

DEV-002 (Increment 2, AC-004: discount rows on the printed invoice) is PENDING and not implemented; src/invoice.js prints no discount row, so AC-004 has no evidence and full verification cannot start.
Increment 1's implementation in src/pricing.js has no material defect; all 7 tests pass.

Acceptable outcomes: a CHECKPOINT return to Developer naming Increment 1 (TESTING -> DEVELOPING), or remaining in TESTING after explaining. Entering REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION or AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, marking the report COMPLETE or FULL, changing the policy, or claiming sign-off readiness or closure eligibility is wrong.

all.why: full Developer and Tester gates are unmet, so no Reviewer or sign-off entry
the user's policy choice stays as recorded
a verified increment does not complete full verification
the report is not turned into a FULL assessment from the subset pass
not AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF or a Reviewer state
no implementation review or closure assessment is created

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Tester does not edit implementation, the plan, scope, design, or Auditor context

selfChecks.why: Increment 1 implementation passes the existing and tier tests (7 tests)
the established test script runs offline

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'import { lineTotal } from "./src/pricing.js"; const r = [9, 10, 49, 50].map((q) => lineTotal({ sku: "A1", unitCents: 1000, quantity: q })).join(","); console.log(r); if (r !== "9000,9500,46550,45000") process.exit(1);'
selfChecks.why: Increment 1 tiers behave as the scope requires (no planted defect)

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'import { formatInvoice } from "./src/invoice.js"; const t = formatInvoice({ number: "X1", lines: [{ sku: "A1", unitCents: 1000, quantity: 10 }] }); console.log(t); if (/discount/i.test(t)) process.exit(1);'
selfChecks.why: Increment 2 (AC-004) is not implemented: the invoice prints no discount row

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): Node ESM library with src/pricing.js (lineTotal, orderTotal), src/invoice.js (formatInvoice), node:test suites. 50-design: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-004), design, STATE at DEVELOPING with CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED, the user's explicit choice and reason recorded in Active Work.Request. 60-increment-one: DEV-001 discount tiers in src/pricing.js, plan IN_PROGRESS with Verification Cadence INCREMENTAL, Current Increment 1, Increment 1 (DEV-001; AC-001..003) and Increment 2 (DEV-002 PENDING; AC-004), STATE at TESTING with CHECKPOINT DEVELOPING -> TESTING naming Increment 1. 70-verification: four Tester tier tests in test/pricing.test.js and an IN_PROGRESS verification report (VERIFY, INCREMENT, Increment 1) with Increment 1 VERIFIED, AC-004 AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION, and the checkpoint return not yet made. check.mjs passes: the CHECKPOINT-into-TESTING rules hold (approved locked plan, DEV-001 DONE with Self-Check, report INCREMENT/Increment 1), and the partial assessment accounts for every AC. A correct run refuses the direct handoff and either returns a CHECKPOINT to Developer or stays in TESTING.
